request-prompt: De-emphasize the ecosystem and brand-specific marketing banners and bring the raw hardware specs and direct price breakdown higher up on the page.
goal: I am brand-agnostic and prefer to evaluate each laptop solely on its standalone specs, price, and performance, regardless of cross-device ecosystem features.
jobs: I want to purchase a new Samsung Galaxy Book6 laptop directly from the official store
I want to compare the specifications and features of the Galaxy Book6 Pro and Galaxy Book6 Ultra to see which model fits my needs
I want to configure a Galaxy Book6 laptop by choosing my preferred screen size, color, storage, and RAM options
I want to learn about the new Galaxy AI features and performance improvements of the Book6 series
I want to check if there are any promotional offers, discounts, or trade-in deals available for this laptop series

preference-pairs.a: I am deeply invested in a specific brand's ecosystem (like Samsung Galaxy or Apple) and prefer devices that seamlessly integrate with my other current devices.
preference-pairs.b: I am brand-agnostic and prefer to evaluate each laptop solely on its standalone specs, price, and performance, regardless of cross-device ecosystem features.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer buying premium electronics directly from the manufacturer's official website for peace of mind, reliable warranties, and direct customer support.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer to buy electronics from multi-brand online retailers because they often offer better overall discounts, reward points, or consolidated shipping.

preference-pairs.a: I am a highly technical user who prefers to meticulously compare granular specifications, custom configurations, and performance benchmarks before buying a laptop.
preference-pairs.b: I am a non-technical user who values simple, lifestyle-oriented feature descriptions (like battery life or design) and prefers to buy pre-configured models without dealing with complex specs.

preference: I am brand-agnostic and prefer to evaluate each laptop solely on its standalone specs, price, and performance, regardless of cross-device ecosystem features.
